headline: NEXIM Secures $30 Million Afreximbank Facility for Nigerian SME Exports
summary: The Nigeria Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) has obtained a $30 million financing facility from the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) to support small and medium-sized enterprise export operations.
why: NEXIM is a government-owned trade policy bank supporting non-oil exports from Nigeria, while Afreximbank is a pan-African multilateral trade finance institution.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Additional credit funding supports domestic SME export growth and foreign exchange liquidity.
